name: plugin-evaluation-kimi
description: Three-layer quality evaluation for OpenAI Codex plugins and skills using Kimi by default.

interface.shortDescription: Score Codex plugins and skills with Kimi
interface.longDescription: Runs deterministic static checks, a structured Kimi/Moonshot judge, and optional Kimi Monte Carlo simulations. Reads PLUGIN_EVAL_KIMI_API_KEY from the user environment.
defaultPrompt: Score this Codex skill with Kimi and explain its weakest dimensions.
